acceptance: Disagreeing UI and protocol evidence becomes a conflicted claim citing both sides; it stays open until an identified decision with a reason is recorded, and unsupported or stale evidence cannot create a conflict.

negative.fixture: unsupported, stale, credential-named, malformed and already-resolved cases; fixtures validated by the protocol schema

versions.schema: vsf-observation-snapshot-v1, vsf-recognition-v1, vsf-evidence-ledger-v1, vsf-availability-v1 new; IR 1.0.0 unchanged

security_and_source_permissions: Credential fields are never matched; protocol documents carry shapes only.
performance_memory_storage: Matching is linear in protocol fields times UI fields.
known_limitations: Required-flag and enum comparison are not yet implemented
